name: weekly_revenue
sql: SELECT store_id, weekofyear(scanned_at) AS week, sum(units * price) AS revenue FROM scans GROUP BY store_id, weekofyear(scanned_at)

name: top_products
sql: SELECT p.product, count(*) AS scan_count FROM scans s JOIN products p ON s.barcode = p.barcode GROUP BY p.product ORDER BY scan_count DESC LIMIT 10

name: promo_lift
sql: WITH promo AS (SELECT barcode FROM promotions WHERE week = 41) SELECT s.barcode, sum(s.units) AS units FROM scans s WHERE s.barcode IN (SELECT barcode FROM promo) GROUP BY s.barcode

name: stockouts
sql: SELECT st.store_name, i.barcode FROM inventory i JOIN stores st ON i.store_id = st.store_id WHERE i.on_hand = 0

name: basket_size
sql: SELECT avg(items) AS avg_basket FROM (SELECT basket_id, count(*) AS items FROM scans GROUP BY basket_id) b

name: revenue_by_store_v2
